questions.question: Which of these should I fix now?

options.label: expo-notifications web warning
options.description: Make notifications-service a no-op on web via a .web.ts variant. Low-risk, web-only. Recommended.

options.label: NativeWind color-scheme error
options.description: Set darkMode:'class' in tailwind.config.js to stop the thrown Error on web. Low-risk, light-only palette unaffected. Recommended.

options.label: Require cycles (task stores)
options.description: Refactor task-store/task-chat-store/task-diff-store/task-lifecycle-store to break circular imports. Cross-platform, larger change, behavior-sensitive.

options.label: expo-av deprecation
options.description: Migrate audio code from expo-av to expo-audio. Cross-platform, larger change, affects the voice/mic flow.
